name: Hero Carousel — next and previous arrow controls cycle motorcycles correctly
description: Verifies that pressing the next and previous arrow buttons rotates the turntable showcase and updates the active motorcycle name and badge.

planSteps.description: Navigate to / and note the currently displayed motorcycle name in the hero title
Click the next arrow button (aria-label 'Next motorcycle') in the bottom carousel dock to advance to the subsequent motorcycle
The active motorcycle headline updates to display the subsequent motorcycle in the collection
The top-center model badge updates to reflect the new active motorcycle name matching the headline
Click the previous arrow button (aria-label 'Previous motorcycle') in the bottom carousel dock
The carousel rotates back and restores the previous motorcycle model name in both the headline and top-center badge
